selector.rationale: Patient presents with fever, flank pain, and foul-smelling urine, with laboratory studies showing leukocytosis, hyponatremia, and positive urinalysis, and blood and urine cultures growing Escherichia coli

rejected.label: Bladder Cancer
rejected.why: While CT scan shows irregular, nodular thickening of the bladder wall, suspicious for neoplasm, the patient's symptoms and lab results more strongly support a diagnosis of urinary tract infection

rejected.label: Nephrolithiasis
rejected.why: Non-obstructing right nephrolithiasis is present, but the patient's symptoms are more consistent with an infectious process

rejected.label: Cytomegalovirus Infection
rejected.why: Patient is on prophylactic valganciclovir for detectable CMV viremia, but the current symptoms and lab results do not support an active CMV infection
